files.notes: Snap's copy check (MAISnapCopyScore): did a take or a camera plate re-render its reference picture's view. Not an identity check: on head crops it scored U53b's grey-haired edit 0.86-0.90, like an edit that kept her hair (U54, U56)

hair_check.source: U56b: L* 90th percentile of the 'hair' mask (eroded 5 px) minus the median over the original take's frames. Grey or silver edits +14 to +41 (U53b seed A akhaliq +41, its Ripple f0/f24 +39/+14); kept, same-take and benign frames at most +9 (U54 take 4 and c1 -11 to -3, day jitter -4 to +5); blonder drift misses (U54 c2 -3/+4, U19 dial +1.5 +8). The margin is 1 L*. Snap's port matches U56b's numbers within 0.4 L* on its 43 frames. n = 2 seeds, 1 scene

files.notes: Snap's pre-screen checks find things by name with core SAM3_Detect: the head (its crop is shown), face and hair for the identity notes, doors, windows and props for the layout check (it reads 'lamp housing' as the floor lantern in the lamp room)

identity_check.source: U56 on SCRFD face boxes, 1.5x: a different woman 0.25-0.34 by day, 0.34-0.45 at night; the same woman 0.58-0.80 by day, 0.34-0.60 at night with a moving head. Snap's crop (1.5x the SAM 3.1 face mask's box) on the same frames: different woman 0.18-0.24 day, 0.38-0.41 night; same take 0.49-0.79 day, 0.34-0.58 night; U54's kept night anchor c1 0.29-0.30 (a false alarm: night anchors against a day frame), its blonder c2 0.13, U53b's silver edit 0.31. It can't see hair colour; the hair check can (proto/test_identity_notes.py). unreliable_for: edits whose method does one of these (methods.json `does`) get the cosine but never the note: under relighting the same woman scores 0.34-0.60 (U56), and on :8193 the kept U54 night anchor c1 0.29/0.32. A note, never a verdict; the head crops (2.4x around each face) decide. n = 2 seeds, 1 scene
